ns2:course.label: Group Counseling
ns2:course.description: Study of the principles of group process and their application in institutional and other settings; includes a review of the historical development of group processes and study of pertinent research; discussion and experiential activities are supplemented by films, videotapes, and case studies. Prerequisite: EPSY 510 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: EPSY 510 or consent of instructor.
